name: Empire State Spring 2022
information: Day 1 Events: 6x6 Cube, 7x7 Cube, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 2x2 Cube, 3x3 Cube, 4x4 Cube, 5x5 Cube **Competitors may bring at most one guest.** This competition will be held in Meeting Room 2, which is on the 1st floor and NOT the same room where the previous two Empire State competitions took place. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue: ##### -They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, April 16th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **OR** ##### -They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, April 26th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
